policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders 'the city of praise,' reflecting the qere construct form rather than the ketiv absolute form.
ASV's name 'Nebuchadrezzar' reflects the qere spelling rather than the ketiv form ending in -zur.
ASV says Nebuchadrezzar has taken counsel 'against you,' selecting the qere second-person plural over ketiv 'against them.'
ASV's main text reads 'the outcasts of Elam,' selecting the qere; its mapped textual-variant note identifies the ketiv sense as the alternative 'the everlasting outcasts.'
ASV's main wording 'I will bring back' distinguishes the qere causative reading; the note 'return to' is classed alternative_rendering and does not decide a textual reading.
ASV's 'the captivity of Elam' does not distinguish the qere and ketiv noun forms, and the only note is classed alternative_rendering, so it cannot decide this unit.
